name: Image Convert
description: Drop images to convert them to JPG, PNG, HEIC or TIFF, optionally smaller, into a folder you choose. The originals stay as they are.

scripts.convert.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# convert.sh <format> <longest side, 0 = keep> <folder> <files JSON>
# Converts each dropped image into the folder you chose, with the Mac's own sips (ImageMagick on Linux). Never overwrites (photo 2.jpg, …),
# never touches the originals. Prints { converted, failed, folder, first } for the card.
format="$1"; size="$2"; folder="$3"; files="$4"
case "$format" in jpeg) ext=jpg ;; png|heic|tiff) ext="$format" ;; *) echo "Unknown format '$format'" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
case "$size" in ''|*[!0-9]*) size=0 ;; esac
[ -d "$folder" ] || { echo "Choose where converted images go first (⋯ › Settings…)" >&2; exit 1; }
if command -v sips >/dev/null 2>&1; then tool=sips
elif command -v magick >/dev/null 2>&1; then tool=magick
elif command -v convert >/dev/null 2>&1; then tool=convert
else echo "Needs sips (on a Mac) or ImageMagick" >&2; exit 1; fi
paths=$(printf '%s' "$files" | jq -r '.[].path') || { echo "Couldn't read the dropped files" >&2; exit 1; }
ok=0; bad=0; first=''
while IFS= read -r src; do
  [ -n "$src" ] || continue
  name=$(basename "$src"); base="${name%.*}"
  dest="$folder/$base.$ext"; n=2
  while [ -e "$dest" ]; do dest="$folder/$base $n.$ext"; n=$((n + 1)); done
  if [ "$tool" != sips ] && [ "$size" -gt 0 ]; then
    "$tool" "$src" -resize "${size}x${size}" "$dest" >/dev/null 2>&1
  elif [ "$tool" != sips ]; then
    "$tool" "$src" "$dest" >/dev/null 2>&1
  elif [ "$size" -gt 0 ]; then
    sips -s format "$format" -Z "$size" "$src" --out "$dest" >/dev/null 2>&1
  else
    sips -s format "$format" "$src" --out "$dest" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  if [ -e "$dest" ]; then
    ok=$((ok + 1)); [ -n "$first" ] || first=$(basename "$dest")
  else
    bad=$((bad + 1))
  fi
done <<EOF
$paths
EOF
[ "$ok" -gt 0 ] || { echo "None of the $bad image(s) could be converted" >&2; exit 1; }
jq -n --argjson ok "$ok" --argjson bad "$bad" --arg folder "$folder" --arg first "$first" \
  '{ converted: $ok, failed: $bad, folder: $folder, first: $first }'

column.hint: PNG, JPG, HEIC, TIFF, WebP… up to 50 at once
